# AI Participation Matrix

> Template: §20.16 — Systems with regular AI participation

| Area | AI Allowed | AI Forbidden | Human Required |
|------|-----------|-------------|----------------|
| Framing | draft / compare / summarize | final meaning decision | owner |
| Routing | score proposal | final track decision | routing owner |
| Build | code draft / refactor suggestion | unreviewed high-risk change | implementer |
| Verify | test support / evidence assembly | final go-no-go alone | reviewer |
| Release | readiness support | release approval alone | approver |
